## 1. 共通データのセット

```{r}

rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# デバッグモードフラグ
debug_mode = TRUE  # デバッグモード
# debug_mode = FALSE # 通常モード

# libraries needed
library(tidyverse)  # most variable creation here uses tidyverse 
library(tidyselect) # used to select variables in FP_EVENTS.R
library(haven)      # used for Haven labeled DHS variables
library(labelled)   # used for Haven labeled variable creation
library(expss)      # for creating tables with Haven labeled data
library(rJava)      # required for xlsx package
library(naniar)     # to use replace_with_na function
library(here)       # to get R project path
library(fs)         # for file path manipulation
library(openxlsx) 　# for exporting to excel
library(survey)       # for survey design


# 各種の関数セット読み込み
source("../myTools.R")  # プロジェクトルートから読み込む（quarto限定の処理）
source("_tool_SaveLabel.R")  # survey用関数群

# 対象とする年のリスト
yearlist <- c("2005", "2006","2007", "2008", "2009", "2010", "2011",
"2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016")

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# ENAHOデータのルートフォルダ指定
gdrive_enaho_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_enaho/output"


# データベース一覧

endes_list <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","endes_data_list.rds"))

# 変数ラベル一覧

endes_var_labels <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "endes_var_labels.rds"))

# ******************************************************************************
# ユーティリティ関数群

source("_tool_safe_join.R")  # left_join_safe関数の読み込み
```

## 2. データ処理

```{r}

library(sjmisc)  # add_rowsのために追加
library(data.table)

data_list <- list()

for (yr in yearlist) {
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("ENDES データ結合処理開始:", yr, "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n\n")

  root_folder <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", yr) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws()
  
  year_data <- read_rds(file.path(root_folder, "data_merged.rds")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(hhid))
  
  if (yr == "2010") {
    labels_memory_org <- save_labels_to_memory(year_data)
  }
  
  year_data <- remove_labels(year_data)
  
  print(paste("Processing year:", yr, "with", nrow(year_data), "records"))
  
  data_list[[yr]] <- year_data
}

# ******************************************************************************
# 全ての年次データの結合
all_data_merged <- rbindlist(data_list, fill = TRUE, ignore.attr = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()

print(paste("Total records:", nrow(all_data_merged)))

# 重複チェック
duplicate_check(all_data_merged, c("year", "caseid"), "all_data_merged")
# ******************************************************************************

# 分析用の共通変数の読み込み
endes_keys <- read_rds(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "endes_keys.rds")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(v026, v024, v005, v021, v022, v025, v001, v002, v003))

# 2005/2006のデータが特殊なため、キーを正規化してマージする
# 正規化済みキーを新しい列として作成
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(
    hhid_trim = str_trim(hhid),
    year_trim = str_trim(year)
  )

endes_keys <- endes_keys %>%
  mutate(
    hhid_trim = str_trim(hhid),
    year_trim = str_trim(year)
  )

# 共通キーでマージ
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  left_join_safe(endes_keys, c("year_trim", "hhid_trim"), diagnose = TRUE)

# 元のキー列（hhid, year）のみを残す
# 正規化キー列（hhid_trim, year_trim）は削除
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  select(-c(hhid_trim, year_trim)) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
  rename_with(~str_remove(., "\\.x$"), ends_with(".x"))

# ================================================================================
# 2. sampling weightの年次補正
# ================================================================================
# 年ごとの元 v005 合計を算出
year_totals <- all_data_merged %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_v005 = sum(v005, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成前に変数を変換
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(
    v021 = as.numeric(v021),                # Primary Sampling Unit
    v022 = as.character(haven::as_factor(v022)) #haven_labelledをfactorに変換してからcharacter
  )

# 正規化済みサンプリングウェイトの作成
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("total_v005"))) %>% # 存在する場合のみ削除
  left_join(year_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    # 元のDHSウェイト
    dhs_weight = v005 / 1e6,
    # 年次正規化係数：全期間対象の標本サイズ比 (例：年の全体ウェイト比)
    year_norm = total_v005 / sum(year_totals$total_v005),
    # 正規化済みウェイト
    sampling_weight_norm = dhs_weight / year_norm,
    # 極端値トリミング
    sampling_weight_trimmed = pmax(
      pmin(sampling_weight_norm,
           quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
      quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

# 元データのラベル適正化

# 変数ラベルの統合

# 1. 元のhaven_labelledデータから変換
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.labelled), labelled::to_factor)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(v021) & !is.na(v022) & !is.na(sampling_weight_trimmed))

row_num <- nrow(all_data_merged)
na_summary_year <- all_data_merged %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(colnames), ~ round(sum(100*is.na(.x))/row_num, 1))) 

m <- apply(na_summary_year, 2, as.numeric)  # 数値マトリクスに
m <- t(m)  # 転置
```
